name: dobe_join_mouth2
desc: Edit only the mouth line on the doberman snout, matching how the reference draws its mouth: one dark mouth line runs from the front of the snout back along the jaw, and only its back end tilts slightly upward; a little apart from that end, a short separate cheek crease line shows the cheek being pushed up. Mouth stays closed. No teeth, no fangs, no eye, no curved U smile, no arrow mark. Everything else stays exactly the same: head shape, ears, body, arm, goo, colors, size and position.
